entities.summary: Paris Peace Accord, a significant document in the history of Vietnam (1969–1975). Part of Vietnam War (Second Indochina War). Shaped Paris Peace Accords signed; US withdraws combat forces and Vietnam invades Cambodia and topples the Khmer Rouge.
